description: A square oscillator whose shape is read from two measured waveforms, one used for low notes and one for high; the maker's own description marks it superseded by Axe

params.text: Sets the frequency, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

inputs.text: Adds to the frequency knob at 1V per octave, with the total held between four octaves below C4 and five above

outputs.text: The square wave, peaking at roughly ±5V

notes: below 20Hz the low waveform is used and above 100Hz the high one; between those two frequencies the module crossfades from one to the other.
the lamp flashes at a hundredth of the oscillator's frequency, so it stays visible at audio rates.
